author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Wonderfall, a third-person post-apocalyptic game developed by Attaboy Interactive. Players will make sense of and control the substance known as Entropy to traverse the city being overtaken by the substance itself. Solve puzzles and seek out the truth in Wonderfall, launching on December 9 for PC (Steam).
title: Wonderfall - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at 'The Stranger Things Collection' Trailer for Dead by Daylight, the hit asymmetrical horror game developed by Behaviour Interactive. Players can check out Rare Outfits for Vecna, Steve Harrington, and Nancy Wheeler as part of Stranger Things Day. The Stranger Things Collection is available now in Dead by Daylight.
title: Dead by Daylight - Official 'The Stranger Things Collection' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at gameplay from Fathom Reach in this launch trailer for the solo roguelike deckbuilder under the sea. Chain card combos and risk deeper dives for more loot. Bring the haul home to grow your deck and build a base that fights while you're away. Fathom Reach is available now on Steam.
title: Fathom Reach - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Console Gameplay Trailer for Guns of Eschaton, a first-person action soulslike shooter developed by Eschatology Entertainment. Players can check out some of the pre-order bonuses, including some peculiar revolvers to use out in the unforgiving wastelands. Guns of Eschaton is launching on December 8 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Guns of Eschaton - Official Console Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Version 1.0 of Void/Breaker is available now on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Xbox Game Pass. Check out the launch trailer for Version 1.0 of Void/Breaker, an adrenaline-fueled roguelite FPS. 

In Void/Breaker, fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through enviro destruction.
title: Void/Breaker - Official 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for The 9th Dragon, an upcoming side-scroller beat 'em up action adventure game. The 9th Dragon combines tactical combat with a dynamic free-style beat ‘em up approach as players navigate the gritty neon maze of Kowloon as Rookie, the newest member of an elite police commando unit. Players will shape the narrative to go either way - will Rookie be a hero, or not? It all depends on the decisions made throughout the story. You can learn more about The 9th Dragon on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4402330/The_9th_Dragon/

The 9th Dragon will be available on PC (Epic Games Store and Steam), PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch. 

#The9thDragon #Gaming #IGN
title: The 9th Dragon - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Vicious Vocab, a cozy word game developed by funcool games, Dane Cook, and Robert Bowling. Players will partake in a fast-paced word brawler by assembling their rack, chaining letters together into illegal combos, and tearing the fabric of reality itself with a well-timed word. Vicious Vocab is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#ViciousVocab #Gaming #IGN
title: Vicious Vocab - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Ruff Day, an upcoming 1-4 player co-op game where you and your friends run a dog daycare that owes the bank a lot of money, and the bank will come to collect. Customers drop off their pups with a list of demands and wishes with some oddly specific notes. You'll be feeding, cleaning, and playing with them to keep them happy. A happy dog = $$! 

Ruff Day will be available on PC (Steam) on December 10, 2026.
title: Ruff Day - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Cybreach, a first-person sci-fi co-op shooter developed by Jas Games. Players will take the fight to Station Ypsilon to fend off waves of cyber-zombies. Use traps, abilities, and powerful weapons in Cybreach, coming soon to PC (Steam).

If you're interested, check out the game on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380410/Cybreach/
title: Cybreach - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Release Date Trailer for My Cat Scattered Games: Tidy Videogame Supermarket, an organizing simulation game developed by Odius. Players will tidy up and organize 4,158 games to restore the video game store. Go at it alone or with friends in co-op in My Cat Scattered Games: Tidy Videogame Supermarket, launching on November 11 for PC (Steam).
title: My Cat Scattered Games: Tidy Videogame Supermarket - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Hacker The Dark Shadow, a simulation hacking game developed by Dark Shadows. Players will embody the early days of a young programmer entering the world of cybercrime. Overcome challenges and prove your value in Hacker The Dark Shadow, launching on December 1 for PC (Steam).
title: Hacker The Dark Shadow - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Conqueror Uzil RAAM Launch Trailer for Gears of War: E-Day, the latest addition to the third-person action shooter franchise developed by The Coalition. Players can celebrate 20 years of Gears of War with the return of Conqueror Uzil RAAM to the game. Access Conqueror Uzil RAAM for free on November 7 in Gears of War: E-Day on Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam).
title: Gears of War: E-Day - Official Conqueror Uzil RAAM Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into the gameplay of Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection in this trailer for the strategy sim game. The Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection, which features all the DLC, is out now on Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2. 

In the Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection, cure a creative crisis in Culture Shock, aid anachronistic ailments in A Stitch in Time, and manage unorthodox ambulances in Speedy Recovery. The DLCs bring 9 hospitals to manage, gameplay mechanics, and over 80 illnesses to cure. The Full Health Collection also includes Bigfoot, Pebberley Island, Close Encounters & Off the Grid expansions, as well as free items, including the Retro Items Pack, Fancy Dress Pack, and more.
title: Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of the Bronze Age leaves early access, and version 1.0 is out now on Steam for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Watch The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of the Bronze Age version 1.0 launch trailer for the stroy-driven, base-building RTS game, which brings Story Act 4 and a new Map Editor.

As drought, famine, and war unravel the Bronze Age world, players lead a small caravan through a character-driven campaign where every settlement must sustain the people defending it. Food powers population, armies, and progress: recruiting more soldiers can secure your borders while straining the fields that keep everyone alive.
title: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Learn about Severian Lowell in the latest Zenless Zone Zero trailer for the urban fantasy action RPG. Zenless Zone Zero is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, PC, Xbox, and Steam. Version 3.2 'Their Secret Histories' of Zenless Zone Zero is out now.
title: Zenless Zone Zero - Official Severian Character Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the ‘A Season-ing’ Trailer for Acornia: Mirror Worlds, an action brawl management adventure game developed by Splashteam. Players will travel from dimension to dimension to take out enemies in one while tending a shop in another. Acornia: Mirror Worlds is launching in Spring 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Acornia: Mirror Worlds - Official ‘A Season-ing’ Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Airframe Ultra, a stylized multiplayer combat racing game developed by Videocult and Akupara Games. Players will race to the death in the streets of Megacity West to kill rivals, take out their bikes, and become the top of the pack. Airframe Ultra is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Airframe Ultra - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the new default face and hear the new voice of The Expanse: Osiris Reborn's male protagonist in this latest trailer for the upcoming action RPG. The new trailer introduces Blythe Melin, who will voice the male Captain and his twin brother J. Additionally, while the protagonist's appearance is fully customizable, the development team has updated the default appearance of the male Captain and his brother.

The Expanse: Osiris Reborn will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG), Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in spring 2027.
title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn - Official VA Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Snow Panic, a multiplayer chaotic online ski racing game developed by KAFI. Players will hurl themselves down a snowy mountain at top speeds to win the race. Keep speeds high, avoid the dangerous wildlife, and make use of weaponry to take out rivals. Snow Panic is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Snow Panic - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for Devil of the Plague to see what to expect with Update 0.9 of the co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Update 0.9 features a new lobby, new mechanics, and a haunting mode. Devil of the Plague is available now in Early Access, and Update 0.9 is out now.

In Devil of the Plague, cleanse cursed lands, perform forbidden rituals, and survive a spreading plague. Fear is not scripted. It emerges from your choices, your mistakes, and your team.
title: Devil of the Plague - Official Update 0.9 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from triMIno in this announcement trailer for the upcoming single-player tile-matching roguelike game. Blending the satisfying connections of dominoes, triminoes and other tiles with the build-crafting of a score-chasing roguelike, triMIno challenges players to turn a handful of tiles into ever more exhilarating point-scoring combos. triMIno will be available on Steam in 2027.
title: triMIno - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this all new BTS look at Where Winds Meet with Hong Kong Cinema legend Yuen Woo-ping! Yuen takes us through how the Dual Spears weapons have been captured in Where Winds Meet, demonstrating his expertise as he guides the dev team to capture their grace and power. 

The new Martial Art Path splits into two distinct styles of offense and defense: Light Spear: charges forward to shatter enemy lines with piercing force.  Heavy Spear: stands firm in defense, biding its time for a crushing counter.   

Dual Spears officially arrives in Where Winds Meet November 26 (UTC) for PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (Steam)!
title: Where Winds Meet - Official Dual Spears Mo-Cap BTS  (Feat.Yuen Woo-ping)

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Project ReMind, a first-person puzzle adventure game developed by Red Hog Studio and Full Dive Games. Players will restore the lost fragments of the first AI consciousness by solving puzzles. Project ReMind is coming soon to PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Project ReMind - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at LocoMo in this trailer for the upcoming cozy city-building life simulator where you don't just build a village, you bring it to life! LocoMo will be available in Early Access on PC (Steam), Mac, and Steam Deck in the second half of 2027, with mobile and console versions planned for later. A demo is coming in the first half of 2027.

In LocoMo, build whatever you imagine, from charming little neighborhoods to sprawling worlds filled with thousands of unique villagers living their own lives. Watch as villagers form relationships, pursue their own interests, and bring your creations to life.

With intuitive building tools, extensive customization, and expanding modding capabilities, including fully swappable tilesets that could transform your world from a medieval village into a cyberpunk city, LocoMo is all about making the world your own.

Create at your own pace, pursue optional challenges, or simply experiment and watch your creations come alive. There's no single righ
title: LocoMo - Official Teaser Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from Harpooner, an upcoming incremental fishing game where a meteor has crashed into the Ocean creating new Alien fish that are slowing taking over. Build your abilities fish by fish to survive the depths for as long as you can. Harpooner will be available on Steam in Q2 2027.
title: Harpooner - Official Gameplay Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: You wake up as a steak. Your only goal is the perfect medium rare. Check out the teaser trailer for Steak Simulator: Medium Rare, an upcoming darkly humorous physics-based platformer. In Steak Simulator: Medium Rare, you drag yourself across a bizarre world using nothing but muscle power, leap into frying pans, and climb toward the ultimate trial and a spot on the global steak leaderboard. Team up with friends as steaks or other ingredients for co-op cooking challenges and high-speed steak races.
title: Steak Simulator: Medium Rare - Official Teaser Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
SoulStream Saga: Chapter 1's latest trailer showcases what you can expect with the Localization Update for the upcoming RPG. SoulStream Saga: Chapter 1 will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.

SoulStream Saga: Chapter 1 is an old-school 2D pixel art JRPG inspired by the SNES and early PlayStation classics, and it is getting ready to speak more languages. Step into Alestria a century after the war between Mages and Alchemists, where a king’s descent into madness threatens everything Astarius Valcrest fought to build. Master Shared ATB combat built on timing, interrupt enemy casts at the right moment and shift elemental stances to exploit weaknesses.
title: SoulStream Saga: Chapter 1 - Official Localization Update Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Step into the boots of an unsung sporting hero in Kitman! Take another look at gameplay from Kitman in this trailer for the upcoming 1-4 player sports management simulator set in the backrooms of a soccer stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan. Kitman will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Kitman - Official Gameplay Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Where Dolls Hang is a psychological survival horror game inspired by Mexican folklore, set in 1998. Investigate an island filled with hanging dolls, eerie mannequins, and horrifying rituals. Explore the forests and interiors with your camcorder, find VHS tapes, and uncover what happened. Check out gameplay in this creepy new Where Dolls Hang trailer. Where Dolls Hang will be available on PC in 2027.
title: Where Dolls Hang - Official Gameplay Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at gameplay from Sole Salvation in this trailer for the upcoming action roguelite hack-and-slash game where you can wield a ranged weapon and a melee weapon simultaneously. The new trailer showcases Sole Salvation's current visuals, combat, mechanics, and systems in their latest state. Sole Salvation will be available in Steam Early Access in Q2 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Sole Salvation - Official Demo Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay and what to expect from Buried Whispers in this trailer for this upcoming chaotic social deduction game. Buried Whispers takes place in fully destructible, procedurally generated caves. Buried Whispers will be available on Steam in Q2 2027.
title: Buried Whispers - Official Beta Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Gateworlds is a colony sim about exploring and surviving a fantasy wilderness. Find your way in a world of floating islands, strange creatures, and fickle gods. Check out the new Gateworlds trailer to see gameplay and more ahead of the game's launch on PC in 2027.
title: Gateworlds - Official Gameplay Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for Dead Mosaic for this upcoming mystery adventure game. Dead Mosaic will be available on PC.

A shifting machine planet, gone silent. Land on Tessus and figure out what happened to its people, with a story that changes every play-through. This is your chance to clear your debt. But watch your back, something is taking out the lights.
title: Dead Mosaic - Official Reveal Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Four drunken pirates in a co-op open-world adventure. One inflatable ship. Zero navigation skills. Here's your look at the reveal trailer for Yo Ho Ho and a Rubber Duck, an upcoming co-op open-world adventure game. Yo Ho Ho and a Rubber Duck will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

In Yo Ho Ho and a Rubber Duck, explore the islands, slap whatever gets in your way and solve bizarre puzzles in this strange Archipelago while you try to reach the greatest treasure of all, the G.O.T.Y., in the craziest treasure hunt you've ever seen.

Will your friends have your back, or will they be too drunk to even notice?
title: Yo Ho Ho and a Rubber Duck - Official Reveal Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026
